logline: Man United's 'standards' are a high-jump bar that keeps dropping — from a treble in 1999 to a draw on the ground in 2026 — and they still trip over it, while Pochettino shouts 'so proud' and a groundsman digs it lower.

beats.idea: 1999: the bar is in the sky — TREBLE — a 1999 jumper flops over it
CLUNK, CLUNK: TOP 4 → ANY TROPHY → EUROPE PLEASE → NOT RELEGATED
2026: the bar lies on the ground: A DRAW; Pochettino watches
Bruno carries Lammens, Tielemans and Amad over it (he scored both), then collapses on the mat
Lammens trips over the bar lying on the ground
Amad celebrates — VAR ❌; Tielemans red card, walks off
Pochettino with a megaphone: SO PROUD! — crickets; a groundsman digs the bar into the ground; next: Leipzig · Bayern · Villarreal; old fan holds a 1999 photo

twist: even with the bar on the ground they trip — and the answer is to dig it lower
callback: the 1999 treble from the first shot returns as the old fan's photo
hidden_details: the next three opponents are written on the buried bar
meme_frame: Bruno carrying three teammates over a bar lying on the ground
